intro: Explosive Consultation is a Westfall assignment involving gnome tinkerer Sprite Jumpsprocket and Alba Fairmoon. Having secured an extraordinarily volatile payload, Sprite entrusts a courier to return the primed charge safely without accidentally setting off the detonator.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That's it - the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
